bagPolicy.summary: For U.S. Rolling Loud festivals, bags must generally be clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC and no larger than 12 x 6 x 12 inches. One-gallon clear freezer bags, small clutches up to 4.5 x 6.5 inches, and empty clear hydration packs are also allowed.
allowed: clear bags up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches
small clutches up to 4.5 x 6.5 inches
prohibited: non-clear backpacks, purses, or bags outside the listed exceptions
bagPolicy.note: This is Rolling Loud's current policy for all U.S. festivals.

parking.note: No current Miami edition or parking plan is posted. Historical Hard Rock Stadium parking guidance should not be treated as an active festival plan.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Rolling Loud Miami's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: A current Miami-specific food and beverage vendor list was not confirmed on Rolling Loud's official site. Review the current Miami event guide when published.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: To help us continually make our event more accessible, we encourage you to contact us at ada@rollingloud.com for any of your accessibility-related needs.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Rolling Loud Miami's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Rolling Loud Miami. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Rolling Loud Miami. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
